mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 3.5% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate labor market strengthening.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE drops below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Co-occurrence of elevated federal funds rates and high unemployment rates creates a contractionary monetary environment that suppresses equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE are above 4.5% and 3.6% thresholds respectively.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the industrial production index below 100 signals an impending slowdown, prompting investors to buy into undervalued equities and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive when INDPRO drops below 100 in a late-cycle expansion context (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A positive quarterly growth in GDP (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity, which compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth positive in last quarter
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive when GDPC1 growth in the last quarter was positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in labor force participation (PAYEMS) above 160,000 triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it signals a robust labor market and potential economic expansion.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive when PAYEMS crosses above 160,000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Co-occurrence of elevated federal funds rates and robust GDP growth (GDPC1) creates a paradoxical environment where investors anticipate future rate cuts, driving up equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive when both FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 are above 4.5% and their last quarter values respectively (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In an industrial contraction regime, a sustained drop in the industrial production index below 100 signals supply-side weakness, prompting investors to seek defensive positions and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly negative when INDPRO drops below 100 in an industrial contraction regime (t-test p > 0.05).
